calibration_status: fixed structural rule
evidence_basis: Park et al. 1991 uses five to six unfolded leaves as a host condition for primary infection forecasting
interpretation_and_constraints: BBCH15 gates infection accumulation inside FSIM; not a symptom-output filter. FSIM-S host-gate synchronization remains deferred.
confounding_or_caveat: Not a pathogen activation date; missing dates are observed or same-site same-variety estimates

calibration_status: fixed structural rule
evidence_basis: Rossi uses 1 January as a computational initialization of the overwintering oospore state
interpretation_and_constraints: Fixed literature-informed initialization; finite perturbation only if start-date sensitivity is reported
confounding_or_caveat: Not evidence that sporangia begin production on 1 January

current_value: previous day 20:00 to current day 07:59; dose available from 08:00
calibration_status: fixed structural rule
evidence_basis: Brischetto requires darkness and nocturnal moisture
interpretation_and_constraints: Fixed process rule; finite perturbation for astronomical-night versus fixed-clock sensitivity
confounding_or_caveat: Fixed-clock darkness is an approximation to local sunrise and sunset

current_value: RH >=80 percent OR rain >0 OR observed leaf wetness >30 min
calibration_status: fixed literature rule; finite perturbation only
evidence_basis: Brischetto defines a moist hour using RH >=80 percent or rain >0 or leaf wetness >30 min
interpretation_and_constraints: Keep 80% as literature-based primary value; perturb within a pre-specified plausible range, do not estimate in the primary calibration
confounding_or_caveat: Missing leaf wetness is an input limitation rather than a parameter to absorb through calibration

calibration_status: fixed literature process switch; finite perturbation only
evidence_basis: Brischetto uses a night-time moist period of at least 3 h
interpretation_and_constraints: Keep 3 h fixed in the primary model; perturb only as structural sensitivity
confounding_or_caveat: Do not estimate from the six onset intervals

calibration_status: fixed literature process switch; finite perturbation only
evidence_basis: Brischetto limits sporulation to moist-period temperatures between 10 and 30 C
interpretation_and_constraints: Keep 10-30 C fixed in the primary model; perturb only as structural sensitivity
confounding_or_caveat: Bounds are distinct from a fitted optimum temperature

primary_value_or_scenario: Lalancette response divided by its value at 20 C and 24 h
calibration_status: fixed literature process equation; finite perturbation only
evidence_basis: Brischetto standardizes the Lalancette et al. 1988 predicted sporangia per lesion area at 20 C and 24 h
interpretation_and_constraints: Use normalized Lalancette-Brischetto response as the primary fixed formulation; perturb equation/scaling only as robustness analysis
confounding_or_caveat: No repeated-sporulation or lesion-age decay term is applied; post-production mortality is separate

current_value: reciprocal of 24 times the Brischetto VPD polynomial applied hourly
primary_value_or_scenario: reciprocal of 24 times the Brischetto VPD polynomial
calibration_status: fixed literature process equation; finite perturbation only
evidence_basis: Brischetto et al. 2020 equations based on Blaeser and Weltzien
interpretation_and_constraints: Use corrected hourly Brischetto equation as primary; perturb mortality coefficients jointly in a bounded robustness analysis
confounding_or_caveat: Historical calibration used an inverted daylight-only implementation and must be repeated

current_value: merged transfer with optional wind gate
primary_value_or_scenario: M0 gate off; M1 gate on
calibration_status: two predefined structures; no structure selected yet
evidence_basis: Brischetto assumes available sporangia can detach disperse and deposit without the current three-threshold formulation
interpretation_and_constraints: Core FirstInfection and CropSeasonFirst.simulate share use_wind_gate; transfer at the beginning of the step, then mortality in one state only.
confounding_or_caveat: Threshold-dependent onset shifts do not prove a correct physical transfer mechanism or compensation.

calibration_status: excluded from current FSIM
evidence_basis: Caffi observed airborne sporangia across broad conditions including rainless periods; Rossi 0.2 mm concerns zoospore splash
interpretation_and_constraints: Retained only for the deferred legacy FSIM-S implementation; neither M0 nor M1 reads this parameter.
confounding_or_caveat: Current value is an extreme hourly event and lacks biological traceability

model_process: optional gate for merged viable-inoculum transfer
primary_value_or_scenario: M1 only; historical value temporarily retained
calibration_status: sensitivity candidate; calibration decision pending
evidence_basis: Caffi cites release above 9 m/s in a wind tunnel but Brischetto specifies no universal field threshold
interpretation_and_constraints: M0 does not use this threshold; M1 uses one shared threshold. No new calibration was performed.
confounding_or_caveat: Empirical proxy; not a demonstrated regional biological constant.

calibration_status: excluded from current FSIM
evidence_basis: Brischetto represents dispersal and deposition jointly with relative D&DR equal to one
interpretation_and_constraints: Retained only for the deferred legacy FSIM-S implementation; neither M0 nor M1 reads this parameter.
confounding_or_caveat: Current value suppresses early cohorts and may duplicate zoospore moisture gates

calibration_status: excluded
evidence_basis: Zoospores require free water; Rossi uses low rainfall for splash/dispersal
interpretation_and_constraints: FSIM and FSIM-S now use physical VPD alone for this leaf-moisture proxy.
confounding_or_caveat: Rainfall remains an input to the separate source-organ sporulation moisture rule.

calibration_status: finite sensitivity parameter; calibrate only if influential
evidence_basis: Low VPD represents humid conditions; current units follow the model VPD calculation
interpretation_and_constraints: Screen first; estimate at most as one shared FSIM parameter within training folds and report the bounded range
confounding_or_caveat: Strongly substitutes for RH wetness threshold

calibration_status: finite sensitivity parameter; primary calibration candidate
evidence_basis: Rossi uses WD x TWD >=60; Hui Wang reports a constrained range approximately 45-88
interpretation_and_constraints: Use literature-constrained 45-90 C h range; estimate at most as one shared FSIM parameter within training folds
confounding_or_caveat: Do not use the historical 50-150 range without justification

screening_range: plus or minus 10 percent grouped robustness
calibration_status: fixed literature process equation; finite perturbation only
evidence_basis: Rossi incubation formulation
interpretation_and_constraints: Keep Rossi coefficients fixed; perturb jointly within a pre-specified narrow range and never use them to absorb onset bias
confounding_or_caveat: No independent infection dates to identify these coefficients

calibration_status: fixed definition
evidence_basis: Keep near one and do not use it to absorb onset bias
interpretation_and_constraints: Shared normalized completion constant, fixed at 1 in both FSIM and FSIM-S; non-1 configurations are rejected.
confounding_or_caveat: Incubation-process uncertainty must not be hidden in a fitted completion criterion.

calibration_status: calibrate only in FSIM-S within training folds
evidence_basis: Use I_threshold(t)=I0*exp(-beta*P(t)) with standardized signed pressure
interpretation_and_constraints: One shared non-negative response parameter; beta=0 defines FSIM; estimate after FSIM parameters are fixed in each training fold

calibration_status: primary objective
evidence_basis: six site-year last-negative/first-positive intervals
interpretation_and_constraints: Zero only when predicted window overlaps (L,U]; report boundary distance, signed direction, window width and no-prediction cases separately
confounding_or_caveat: Exact-date or midpoint loss is secondary sensitivity analysis

calibration_status: design fixed before final evaluation
evidence_basis: site-year is the independent unit (n=6)
